files.description: Fireworks recorded using a combination of Tascam DR-05 onboard mics and Tascam DR-60 using a stereo pair of lavalier mics and a Sennheiser MD421. I removed some voices with Izotope RX 5, then added some low punch and high crispness with EQ.
files.author: kingsrow
